modules.name: Authentication
modules.description: User-facing authentication page and supporting access-control foundations.

tasks.title: Design authentication page
tasks.description: Define the authentication page layout, states, and responsive behavior; authentication workflows are not specified.
tasks.rationale: A user-facing page needs a design before implementation; keep workflow assumptions limited to the brief.

tasks.title: Build authentication page
tasks.description: Implement the responsive authentication page UI and connect it to the agreed authentication interface.
tasks.rationale: Delivers the requested page while leaving unspecified authentication details to be clarified.

tasks.title: Provide authentication service
tasks.description: Implement backend authentication endpoints and session or token handling needed by the page; confirm supported flows and identity provider before implementation.
tasks.rationale: A functional authentication page typically requires backend support, though the exact workflow is unspecified.

tasks.title: Review authentication security
tasks.description: Review authentication implementation for common security risks and verify access-control behavior against agreed flows.
tasks.rationale: Authentication handles sensitive access and warrants a focused security review.

tasks.title: Test authentication page
tasks.description: Test authentication page rendering, validation, and agreed authentication flows across supported browsers and devices.
tasks.rationale: Validates the page and its supporting behavior; exact flows need confirmation.

modules.name: Production Listing
modules.description: User-facing page for listing production information.

tasks.title: Design production listing page
tasks.description: Design the production listing layout, information hierarchy, and responsive states; data fields and interactions require clarification.
tasks.rationale: The listing page needs a defined presentation, while the brief does not specify its content or behavior.

tasks.title: Build production listing page
tasks.description: Implement the production listing UI and connect it to the agreed data interface.
tasks.rationale: Delivers the requested user-facing listing page.

tasks.title: Provide production listing data
tasks.description: Implement or expose backend data retrieval for the production listing once its data source, fields, and access rules are agreed.
tasks.rationale: A listing generally needs data from a backend, but the source and schema are unspecified.

tasks.title: Test production listing page
tasks.description: Verify listing display, data loading, empty/error states, and responsive behavior against agreed requirements.
tasks.rationale: Ensures the page works with expected data and states.

modules.name: Selling
modules.description: User-facing selling page and supporting transaction capability, with transaction details to be clarified.

tasks.title: Design selling page
tasks.description: Design the selling page and its responsive states; clarify whether it supports product selection, checkout, or another selling workflow.
tasks.rationale: The page is requested, but its intended selling workflow is not specified.

tasks.title: Build selling page
tasks.description: Implement the selling page UI and connect it to agreed product and transaction interfaces once the workflow is defined.
tasks.rationale: Delivers the requested page without assuming a specific checkout or sales flow.

tasks.title: Implement selling capability backend
tasks.description: Implement backend support for the agreed selling workflow, including relevant product or transaction operations; confirm scope before implementation.
tasks.rationale: A selling capability may require backend operations, but the brief does not define them.

tasks.title: Test selling page and workflow
tasks.description: Test the selling page and agreed end-to-end selling behavior, including relevant error and boundary cases.
tasks.rationale: Validates the page and any transaction behavior once the workflow is clarified.

modules.name: Cash Paycheck
modules.description: User-facing page for a cash paycheck capability; the meaning and operational workflow need clarification.

tasks.title: Design cash paycheck page
tasks.description: Design the page layout and states after clarifying what cash paycheck means and which user actions it supports.
tasks.rationale: The requested page is ambiguous, so design depends on clarifying its purpose and workflow.

tasks.title: Build cash paycheck page
tasks.description: Implement the responsive page UI and connect it to agreed interfaces after the cash paycheck workflow is defined.
tasks.rationale: Provides the requested page while avoiding assumptions about financial operations.

tasks.title: Implement cash paycheck capability backend
tasks.description: Implement backend operations required by the agreed cash paycheck workflow; confirm data, authorization, and any financial processing requirements first.
tasks.rationale: Backend needs depend on the unspecified meaning and workflow of cash paycheck.

tasks.title: Test cash paycheck page and workflow
tasks.description: Test the page and agreed workflow, including authorization, validation, and relevant failure cases.
tasks.rationale: Testing scope depends on clarification of the capability, particularly if it involves financial operations.

modules.name: Product Recommendations
modules.description: Customer-facing machine-learning product recommendation capability; delivery channel and data requirements are unspecified.

tasks.title: Define recommendation scope and data needs
tasks.description: Clarify customer delivery channel, recommendation use case, available product/customer data, success measures, and privacy constraints.
tasks.rationale: The capability is requested, but channel, data, and expected behavior are not specified.

tasks.title: Develop product recommendation model
tasks.description: Assess available data and develop or select a recommendation approach, with offline evaluation against agreed success measures.
tasks.rationale: Machine learning recommendation logic is explicitly required; model choice depends on data and goals.

tasks.title: Prepare recommendation data pipeline
tasks.description: Assess and prepare the required product and customer data for model development and serving, subject to data availability and approved access.
tasks.rationale: Recommendations typically require usable data inputs, but source systems and data readiness are unknown.

tasks.title: Integrate recommendation serving
tasks.description: Expose the agreed recommendation output through a serving interface suitable for the confirmed customer delivery channel.
tasks.rationale: A model must be made available to the customer experience; the delivery channel is unspecified.

tasks.title: Present recommendations to customers
tasks.description: Implement the customer-facing recommendation presentation in the confirmed delivery channel; page placement and interaction are to be determined.
tasks.rationale: The capability is intended for customers, but its delivery channel is not specified.

tasks.title: Validate recommendation capability
tasks.description: Test recommendation integration, output handling, and customer presentation against agreed functional and quality criteria.
tasks.rationale: Validates the end-to-end capability once channel and acceptance criteria are defined.

modules.name: Admin
modules.description: User-facing admin page and supporting administrative operations, with scope and permissions to be clarified.

tasks.title: Design admin page
tasks.description: Design the admin page layout and states after clarifying the administrative tasks, user roles, and information to display.
tasks.rationale: The page is requested, but its administrative purpose and content are unspecified.

tasks.title: Build admin page
tasks.description: Implement the admin page UI and connect it to agreed administrative interfaces and access rules.
tasks.rationale: Delivers the requested page while avoiding assumptions about admin functions.

tasks.title: Implement admin operations
tasks.description: Implement backend operations required by the agreed admin scope, including authorization checks for administrative actions.
tasks.rationale: Admin pages commonly require protected operations, but the required operations are not specified.

tasks.title: Test admin page and permissions
tasks.description: Test admin page behavior, agreed administrative operations, and role-based access restrictions.
tasks.rationale: Admin functionality needs validation, especially around access restrictions.

modules.name: Delivery Foundations
modules.description: Cross-cutting project coordination, environments, delivery automation, review, and regression testing.

tasks.title: Coordinate delivery and communication
tasks.description: Coordinate planning, stakeholder communication, dependency tracking, and scope clarification across the project.
tasks.rationale: Project management and communication are required cross-cutting delivery activities.

tasks.title: Set up development and test environments
tasks.description: Provision and document development and test environments and access needed by the delivery team.
tasks.rationale: Teams need usable environments to build and verify the requested capabilities.

tasks.title: Set up CI/CD pipeline
tasks.description: Configure build, automated checks, and deployment pipeline appropriate to the agreed environments and release process.
tasks.rationale: CI/CD is a required hidden delivery task for repeatable integration and deployment.

tasks.title: Review implementation changes
tasks.description: Perform code reviews for implementation changes, checking maintainability, correctness, and adherence to agreed conventions.
tasks.rationale: Code review is a required hidden quality and collaboration activity.

tasks.title: Run cross-feature regression testing
tasks.description: Run regression testing across delivered pages and capabilities before release, including agreed supported environments.
tasks.rationale: Cross-feature regression testing is required beyond feature-specific QA tasks.
